description: Election Commission - A. D. C. N. Wijegunawardhana was elected as the member of the Niyagama Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government authority (Niyagama Pradeshiya Sabha) due to a member ceasing to belong to their political party. It involves the electoral process under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, specifically the nomination and declaration of a newly elected member to fill the vacant seat. This falls under electoral processes and related matters, making it an Elections Gazette.
